mapper.sql: company_currencies.id AS id, company_currencies.company_id AS companyId, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, companies.name AS companyName, (SELECT CONCAT(currency_centers.name, "(", currency_centers.symbol, ")") FROM currency_centers WHERE id = 1) AS currencyFrom, company_currencies.currency_center_id AS currencyToId, CONCAT(currency_centers.name,"(", currency_centers.symbol, ")") AS currencyTo, is_pos_default AS isPosDefault, DATE_FORMAT(currency_centers.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(currency_centers.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM company_currencies LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = company_currencies.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = company_currencies.modified_by LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = company_currencies.company_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = company_currencies.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id=company_currencies.branch_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_currencies( `company_id`, branch_id, currency_center_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{companyCurrency.companyId}, #{companyCurrency.branchId}, #{companyCurrency.currencyFromId}, NOW(), #{companyCurrency.createdBy}, #{companyCurrency.isActive} );
mapper.update: UPDATE company_currencies SET `company_id` = #{companyCurrency.companyId}, `branch_id` = #{companyCurrency.branchId}, `currency_center_id` = #{companyCurrency.currencyFromId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{companyCurrency.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{companyCurrency.id}
mapper.select: SELECT company_id FROM company_currencies WHERE id = #{companyCurrencyId};
